annotations.text:
freeagent · phone

GitHub is the account. Hugging Face and Railway are connected under it. No prose on any screen: a wordmark, the list, one action.

Research takeaways applied: one primary action per screen in thumb reach · 44px+ targets · bottom sheets instead of dialogs · bold type, generous space · status as colour + one word.
A · Collie-native. Same tokens as the app you land in (Aldrich, 2px radius, Collie status colours, rules not cards). Trade-off: quietest of the three; relies on type and rhythm, not shape.
B · Bold minimal. Oversized headline, soft cards, one accent, floating pill CTA. Trade-off: a different world from Collie's dark 2px UI, so the hand-off will feel like a jump.
C · Bento. Two-column tiles, glowing status dot, the last tile is New box. Trade-off: repo names truncate hard at 170px, and a long list scrolls in pairs.

Flow in direction A.

Sign in: mark, wordmark, one button.
Boxes: rows, status word + provider tag, New box pinned bottom.
Accounts: bottom sheet from the avatar. GitHub row signs out; the others Connect / Disconnect. Disconnect greys out while boxes exist on that account.
New box: where (only connected accounts appear), repository, name. Create.
